title: Flávio Bolsonaro and Vorcaro: new $1.6M transfer to Dark movie
seoTitle: Flávio Bolsonaro and Vorcaro: new $1.6M transfer
subtitle: Investigation reveals payment in September 2025 following pressure from the senator
excerpt: Magazine piauí reported Daniel Vorcaro sent $1.6 million to Havengate fund to finance Dark Horse, eight days after Flávio Bolsonaro demanded payment.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: revista piauí, G1, Partido dos Trabalhadores
contentHtml:
A new transfer of $1.6 million to the Havengate Development Fund, responsible for financing the movie "Dark Horse," was revealed following a Coaf investigation. The payment, made on September 16, 2025, occurred eight days after Flávio Bolsonaro demanded overdue installments from the former banker.

What the Coaf report reveals

The document, obtained by piauí magazine, shows that the transfer reached the American fund through the company Entre Investimentos e Participações, linked to Daniel Vorcaro. Until then, Flávio Bolsonaro claimed that Vorcaro's last payment had been in May 2025.

How the payment fits with previous transfers

Before this new remittance, six transfers had been identified – two of $2 million and four of $1.6 million – totaling $10.6 million. With the September amount, the proven total rises to $12.3 million, which corresponds to over 65 million reais at the exchange rate of the time.

Flávio Bolsonaro's pressure and new installment in October

WhatsApp messages showed that Flávio demanded payment from Vorcaro on September 8, and the payment was made eight days later. On October 22, Flávio sent a new message asking for the release of installments; advertising executive Thiago Miranda questioned Vorcaro, who replied, "Yes. I released another one today." If this payment took place, the total would reach $14 million, about 72 million reais.

Impact on the investigations

The case is under two inquiries at the Supreme Federal Court (STF): one regarding Vorcaro's transfers and another concerning the alleged use of parliamentary amendments by the production company Go Up Entertainment. The Federal Police are also investigating the money trail, which passed through a money broker and the Havengate fund, managed by Paulo Calixto, a friend of Eduardo Bolsonaro.

Flávio Bolsonaro's position

When questioned about the new transfer, Flávio stated that he has no information and suggested that the production company be consulted. His press office reiterated that the matter is not the senator's responsibility.

With information from piauí magazine, G1, Workers' Party.
